name: workflows
description: Create Python workflows from plain-English goals to run Kiro Crew agents through ordered phases. Scripts are checked against sandboxed workflow commands before execution. Follow live phase and agent events, or start from the included runnable examples.
author: kirocrew
highlights: Validate a workflow before running it — errors surface without anything executing
Watch the run live, phase by phase, with per-agent progress events
Scripts are limited to a sandboxed workflow API rather than arbitrary Python
Usually authored for you from a plain-English goal, then editable by hand
Ships with runnable examples to start from
useCases: Validate and inspect restricted workflow scripts or monitor core multi-agent workflow runs phase by phase.
configuration: Enable the hidden app with kirocrew app enable workflows; validate DSL Python in Author, or use chat or MCP workflow tools when you need real agent orchestration and monitor it in Runs.
